message.Title: Public Preview: Azure Databricks Private network gateway

Body.Content:
Private network gateway for Azure Databricks is now in Public Preview, enabling serverless compute to connect to resources in your virtual network (VNet) and transitively connected networks through a single managed gateway. Customers can use the gateway to access multiple private resources, route serverless egress through their own firewalls or network security appliances, and use stable, identifiable source IP addresses. 

This simplifies secure connectivity for serverless workloads while giving organizations greater control over network traffic and access to private resources. 

Private network gateway integrates with existing network connectivity configurations (NCCs) and complements Azure Private Link, providing additional flexibility for securing serverless network connectivity. 

Learn more.
